description:
Project: On-prem offline artifact signing (Private Deployment Automation)

Goal
- Enable secure, repeatable air-gapped installations of Redwood Private by shipping signed “offline bundles” (container images + Helm charts/manifests + binaries + metadata) and adding verification steps in the installer.
- Provide cryptographic integrity guarantees for all artifacts moved via removable media / offline repositories, with auditable provenance suitable for regulated customers.

Scope
- Define an offline bundle format (bundle manifest, checksums, SBOM/provenance pointers, signing envelope).
- Implement a signing step in release/build pipelines and publish signatures alongside bundles.
- Implement verification in the on-prem installer (fail-closed by default; support break-glass with explicit acknowledgement).
- Key management and operational processes: signing key storage (KMS/HSM-backed), access controls, rotation, and incident response for key compromise.
- Documentation: internal runbooks + customer-facing installation/verification guide.

Non-goals
- Full customer-managed signing (customer provides keys and signs Redwood artifacts) for v1; may be explored as a follow-on.
- Replacing all existing artifact distribution mechanisms; v1 targets air-gapped/offline bundle path.

Stakeholders / teams
- Product: Vivek Kulkarni (Private Deployments), Naomi Feldman (Security & Compliance)
- Engineering: Priya Natarajan (Platform), Ethan Park (Control Plane), Connor O’Brien (Release Engineering), Sahana Iyer (Build/CI)
- Security: Marcus Lin (Security Engineering), Kevin Osei (audit/export + enterprise controls), Dr. Aisha Rahman (exec sponsor)
- Infra/SRE: Irene Choi (Infra), Victor Alvarez (networking constraints for Private)
- Solutions Engineering: Markus Klein, Fatima Noor (regulated/air-gapped deployments)

Key decisions / constraints
- Verification must work fully offline (no outbound calls).
- Fail-closed defaults for integrity verification; support explicit override for emergency only with audit trail.
- Must support multiple artifact types (OCI images, Helm charts, binaries, config bundles) with a single bundle-level verification story.
- Reproducibility and traceability: link bundle to release version, commit SHAs, and CI attestations.

Timeline (hypothetical)
- Phase 0 (1–2 weeks): requirements collection + customer constraints; define threat model.
- Phase 1 (2–4 weeks): bundle format + signing pipeline; produce signed bundles in staging.
- Phase 2 (2–4 weeks): installer verification + UX; end-to-end air-gapped test in lab.
- Phase 3 (2–3 weeks): pilot with 1–2 private customers; documentation + runbooks.
- Phase 4 (GA): key rotation plan, monitoring, and support readiness.

Deliverables
- Confluence design spec + ADRs, threat model, key management runbook, installer verification runbook.
- Linear project with epics/issues across release engineering, installer, security, docs.
- GitHub PRs across `redwood-private-installer`, `redwood-helm-charts`, and `redwood` (release tooling).
- Slack coordination threads; Jira support artifacts for pilot issues; customer-facing enablement drafts in Drive; CRM + call transcripts for customer requirements capture.

files.description: High-level overview of signed offline bundles: motivation (air-gapped installs), supported artifact types, user workflow, compatibility guarantees, and ownership.
Detailed v1 bundle specification: directory layout, manifest schema, checksum strategy, signature envelope, versioning rules, and forward-compat considerations.
Installer changes to verify signatures/checksums offline; UX (errors, override flow), logging/audit requirements, and how verification integrates with existing install steps.
ADR documenting the chosen signing approach (bundle-level signing + per-artifact digests), rationale vs alternatives, and security trade-offs.
Threat model for offline bundle distribution: attacker goals, trust boundaries, mitigations (key protection, replay prevention, downgrade protections), and residual risks.
CI/CD design for adding a signing stage: inputs, provenance metadata, KMS/HSM integration, failure modes, and how artifacts are published.
How upgrades/rollbacks work with signed bundles; compatibility matrix, handling partial upgrades, and rollback safety constraints.
Operational runbook for customers/SEs: verify bundle signature, validate manifest, troubleshoot verification failures, and collect diagnostics for support.
Policy for break-glass overrides (when allowed, approval, logging), including required customer acknowledgement language and internal escalation steps.
Control mapping to SOC2/ISO-style requirements: software integrity, change management, key management, and evidence artifacts produced by CI.
Kickoff meeting notes (working doc): goals, initial requirements, open questions, owners, and links to early drafts/Linear epic.
Release engineering implementation plan draft: task breakdown, CI changes, environments, milestones, and responsibilities.
Test plan for air-gapped lab: hardware/software matrix, steps to simulate offline repo/media transfer, expected outputs, and acceptance gates.
Early draft of the manifest JSON schema with example fields, notes on versioning, and unresolved questions before Confluence spec is finalized.
Working notes for signing key ceremony: roles, approvals, audit trail requirements, access reviews, and rotation schedule.
Pilot plan draft: candidate customers, success criteria, rollout steps, support coverage, and feedback capture plan.
PM initiative ticket defining the customer problem, success metrics, scope boundaries, rollout plan, and coordination across Eng/Sec/SE.
Engineering epic for implementing bundle build output + manifest generation; acceptance criteria include deterministic manifests and versioned schema.
Issue for adding signing to CI/CD: key access, attestation metadata, and publishing signatures with artifacts.
Issue for installer verification: signature validation, checksum verification, fail-closed behavior, and user-facing error messages.
Implement explicit override flag + logging; include security review requirement and documentation updates.
Add SBOM/provenance references (or embedded artifacts) to offline bundle manifest and document how customers can validate them offline.
Add CI integration tests that generate a bundle, sign it, and run installer verification in a hermetic/offline mode.
Docs task to create customer-facing guidance and internal support SOP, linking to Confluence runbooks.
Security/infra task for key rotation + revocation strategy; define how old bundles remain verifiable and how compromised keys are handled.
Add structured logs/events for verification outcomes, override usage, and troubleshooting fields (without leaking secrets).
PR: Add offline bundle verification command to installer CLI; includes signature verification stub, error handling, and unit tests.
PR: Implement fail-closed verification before unpack/install; includes UX text, exit codes, and logging improvements.
PR: Add break-glass override flag with explicit acknowledgement prompt and audit log entry; security review comments included.
PR: Add integration test harness that runs verification in a simulated air-gapped environment (no network) using a test key.
PR: Package Helm charts into offline bundle output and emit chart digests into the manifest; includes minor chart metadata normalization.
PR: Release tooling updates to produce offline bundle artifacts (images list + binary payloads) and publish to artifact storage.
PR: Add signing stage to release pipeline config; integrates with KMS/HSM-backed signer and uploads detached signatures.
PR: Add provenance metadata generation (commit SHAs, build ids) and include references in bundle manifest; includes reviewer discussion on determinism.
PR: Add structured logging/eventing around verification and install provenance for Private deployments; includes metrics hooks.
PR: Draft customer documentation for signed offline bundles (install + verify steps), plus troubleshooting section and FAQ.
Thread coordinating release engineering changes for signing: KMS permissions, CI secrets, and rollout sequencing.
Thread reviewing threat model and debating break-glass behavior; includes requested changes and sign-off criteria.
Thread on build pipeline integration details: hermetic builds, artifact storage layout, and CI performance impact.
Thread clarifying bundle format decisions (manifest fields, versioning) and linking to the draft Drive schema.
Thread triaging a pilot customer verification failure; requests logs, identifies mismatch between manifest digests and unpacked artifacts.
Support ticket from a Private/enterprise customer: offline install fails verification after media transfer; includes environment details, logs, and workaround discussion.
Support ticket: customer requests documentation for signature verification and key rotation assurances; routed to SE + Security with links to Confluence.
Internal ticket: request for new KMS/HSM key and access policy for signing service; includes approvals and audit requirements.
Technical deep dive transcript with a regulated prospect about air-gapped installs, artifact integrity, and requirements for signed bundles; action items include sharing draft docs.
CRM company record for an air-gapped/on-prem prospect: deployment requirements (air-gapped), security needs, timeline, linked Fireflies meeting, and next steps.
Email thread between AE/SE and prospect security team: answers about signing approach, verification behavior, key management, and sharing draft installation guide (attachments referenced).
Leadership/security approval thread: final decision on signer key custody, access controls, rotation cadence, and incident procedure for key compromise.
